meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

copy.tagline: 把不同标准的基因位置统一起来，避免分析出错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常处理基因数据，总被不同位置标注弄晕。
copy.tagline_en: Unify genomic coordinates between different formats to avoid mismatches.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic position data and often get confused by coordinate differences.

howto.what: 坐标在两个格式、工具或参考基因组之间转换时,它按换算表做 0-based/1-based 换算、归一化并比对变异表示,并在拼接前检查 contig 命名与组装版本是否一致。
howto.when: 当坐标跨格式、工具或组装边界时接管,例如 0-based/1-based 换算、归一化并比对变异、检查组装与 chr 前缀等。

say.text: 把 peaks.bed 转成 GTF,顺便检查有没有违反格式约定。
say.note: 逐个区间报告转换状态。

howto.what_en: When coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary, it converts them using the convention table, normalises and compares variant records, and checks contig naming and assembly before a join.
howto.when_en: It takes over whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary, such as 0-based/1-based conversion, normalising or comparing variants, or assembly and chr-prefix checks.

say_en.text: Convert peaks.bed to GTF and flag any convention violations.
Use ref.fa to check if chr1:7:CAC:C and chr1:2:GCA:G are one deletion.
Check whether variants.vcf and annotation.gtf use the same assembly.
